shared_current_isolation: B/C consume one exact current map object and the same query tensor; only reference content changes. Matched roundtrip control bounds interpolation explanations, not actual visibility/age.
counterexample: With equal norm feature pairs [appearance,dynamic], appearance cos=1-epsilon, old target dynamic +v and current target -v while distractor +v, early wrong-minus-own=(2*gamma^2-epsilon)/(1+gamma^2)>0 for gamma^2>epsilon/2. This only disproves unconditional earlier-is-better, not an observed cause in FlyVis.
